universal.bridge_headline: Everything below assumes you shopped for it.

bridge_beats.title: Wednesday stops being a decision.
bridge_beats.detail: You open the fridge, name three things, and the meal is already chosen. The deciding was the tiring part, not the cooking.

bridge_beats.title: The half-bag of spinach gets eaten.
bridge_beats.detail: Cooking from what is already there means the wilting thing becomes tonight, instead of becoming Sunday's bin.

bridge_beats.title: You stop buying the same three things twice.
bridge_beats.detail: When the kitchen is already accounted for, the store trip gets shorter. Nothing gets bought because you could not remember.

universal.provenance_line_reviewed: Recipes on this page are developed with the iEatz recipe engine and edited by a person before publishing. Times, servings and protein figures are tested against the written method.
